### Borea v0.5.2

A patch release for v0.5.1, with Simplified Chinese as a new language. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Simplified Chinese

- Borea now speaks Simplified Chinese. Pick it under Settings > General > Language. When the language of your system is Simplified Chinese, Borea starts in it by itself. Many thanks to @kuxiaowo, who translated all of Borea.
- Settings > About now names the translators of each language.

#### Fixes

- A setting that Borea could not save is no longer lost when you change another setting. The next save keeps it.
- One broken text in the content index no longer stops the whole index from loading. Borea skips only that value.
- SpaceDock page and download links always stay on spacedock.info.
- On Linux, when KSA crashes, Borea now names the mod also when its folder name differs from the mod id only in upper and lower case.
- A mod that the content index removed no longer comes back on its mod page from SpaceDock.
- When Borea checks a mod folder that you installed by hand, it removes its temporary files also when the download cannot be deleted.
- When the content index has a bad shape, the error says why in one sentence.

#### For mod authors

- In the listing editor, when you stop one image check, the other checks of images on the same branch still finish.

#### Good to know

- This version is tested with KSA 2026.10.19.5638.
- Borea is a community project by the KSA Modding team. It is not made by RocketWerkz.
